# Both implementations must interpret every record identically.
# Rule ZSLP-VOUT0: an SLP message counts only when it is the script of vout[0] (which must start with OP_RETURN).
# Rule ZNAM-OWNER-2: the owner of a name transaction is the address of the output its first input spends,
#   rendered by script type: exact P2PKH -> P2PKH address, exact P2SH -> P2SH address, anything else -> no owner.
# Both rules apply from genesis (mainnet census to block 3323972: 0 SLP messages outside vout[0], 0 ZNAM messages).
# Records (one per line, '|' separated, '#' comments, transactions are version 1 transparent):
#   slp|<id>|<tx hex>|<expect>              expect = none | genesis | mint | send (what the index reads from the transaction)
#   znam|<scenario>|<step>|<prev script hex>|<tx hex>|<expect>
#       the transaction spends, with its first input, an output whose script is <prev script hex>; steps of one scenario
#       run in order against one empty name index (block heights are not part of the expectation);
#       expect = <name>=<owner address>/<target type>:<target value>  or  <name>=-  (the name does not exist) after the step
# Mainnet address prefixes (ZClassic): P2PKH 1CB8, P2SH 1CBD.
